title: 9/10 (Thu) Update Notice - Season [The Farside]
tldr: The Farside is Undecember's September 2026 season. It brings Season-only Erosion gear options, the 100-wave Agony Wave defense mode, the full Card system, a new Zodiac specialization and Rune Cast Presets for swapping builds. New skill and link runes arrive, most damaging skills gain about 4% at Lv. 45, several channeled skills now work on the move, and Leo's Animosity, Intensify Pain, Bleed and Burn are nerfed.
highlights: Season-only Erosion gear options during The Farside
Agony Wave: a defense mode of up to 100 timed waves with Blessing-and-Curse picks
The Card system fully launches, and Rune Cast Presets save whole builds
New skill runes Charged Shot and Divine Punishment, plus five new link runes and two Transcendent ones
Nerfs to Leo's Animosity, Intensify Pain, Bleed and Burn

changes.text: Open to new or reverted characters, with growth boosts such as +300% Alchemy Mastery EXP and +50% item drop chance.
Strong Erosion gear options, like Erosion DMG % Amplification, can appear only on Season-mode gear this season.
A new Saluto defense mode, entered with an Agony Key from Chaos Dungeon, runs up to 100 waves with 30 seconds each.
Each wave offers three linked Blessing-and-Curse options you can reroll or block, and wave bosses drop Agony Shards that open reward chests.
Cards fully launch (unlocked after Act 13), drop from Chaos Dungeon, Agony Wave and events, and give Album and Deck bonuses, while The Forge card data is wiped.
Save and reload full rune setups, including triggers, runestones and quick slots; one preset is free and Rubies unlock up to five.
New Bowgun skill rune that charges in stages and fires a piercing shot, reaching 1766% Physical DMG at Lv. 45.
New channeled lightning spell that strikes every enemy in a 400-range field, with a 40% chance on crit to add an enhanced strike.
Five new link runes (Haste, Sure Hit, Trance, Overconsumption and the sentry rune Illegal Mod) plus two new Transcendent link runes.
One new Zodiac specialization line is added, with four tiers: Birth, Persistence, Bloom and Void.
Most damaging skill runes gain about 4% at Lv. 45; Meteor, for example, goes from 2100% to 2184% Fire DMG.
Most link runes get small Lv. 45 increases; for example, Melee DMG Amplification goes from 22.2% to 24%.
Gains a 150-range explosion dealing 900% (+1900) Cold DMG at Lv. 45, but its Chilling Area damage falls from 267% (+564) to 76% (+159).
Lv. 45 Status Effect DMG Amplification is cut from 218.5% to 140%.
Now usable while moving, auto-aims and applies Arson during the channel, but per-stage Fire amplification drops from 20% to 15%.
Now usable while moving with auto-targeting, and its 30-stack Maintain Position buff becomes a 10-stack Blessing worth 3% damage amplification per stack.
Domain of Strength, Sacred Devotion and Enchanted Sentry can now be channeled while moving.
Lv. 45 Physical DMG rises from 598% (+339) to 933% (+530).
The elemental versions lose their +3 max Energy and instead give +50% and 4% amplified damage of their element per matching Energy at Lv. 45, limited to one per skill.
Trigger chance goes from 70% to 100%.
Most seals get bigger Source and Origin bonuses (Condensed Destruction from +165% to +191%), while the Dodge, Defense and Crowd Control Dodge seals get slightly smaller ones.
Newly obtained copies roll much lower (DMG amplification from [120~140]% to [60~70]%), and their penalties now stack per 6 equipped runes instead of per 10, with no cap.
Bleed no longer ignores Armor, and Burn no longer ignores Element Resist.
Lets runes at level 31 or higher grow past the old cap toward Lv. 45 and beyond, but each use may add, keep or remove one level.
A high-risk Essence for Rare or better gear with a small chance to double or halve Quality and options; the gear becomes untradable and uses per item are limited.
Moved into Chaos Dungeon, where a Memory Rune (Time) guarantees the event and Zodiac Stones drop, and the old separate entrance is removed.
Abyss Gate gets 13 new Abyss Stones: 9 Destruction and 4 Distortion.
Emerald Ether replaces White Night Crystal, special materials now double tradable Essence drops instead of adding untradable ones, and Treasure Chests spawn less often.
